abstract: <jats:title>Abstract</jats:title><jats:p>Fusarium head blight (FHB) is a major concern for wheat production and food safety, globally. Resistance to infection (type I resistance) is important for breeding varieties with good FHB resistance. To better understand the genetic architecture underlying type I FHB resistance, quantitative trait loci (QTL) mapping was conducted using two recombinant inbred line populations derived from the crosses Yangmai 4 (YM4)/Yanzhan 1 (YZ1) and Yangmai 5 (YM5)/YZ1. A total of five resistance QTL, including <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐2D</jats:italic>, <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐4D</jats:italic>, <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐5B</jats:italic>, <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐6B</jats:italic>, and <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐3A</jats:italic>, were detected from these two populations. Except for <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐2D</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐5B</jats:italic>, the resistance effects of all the other QTLs are derived from YM4 or YM5. <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐4D</jats:italic> is a common QTL detected both in YM4/YZ1 and YM5/YZ1 populations. <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐2D</jats:italic>, <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐4D</jats:italic>, and <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐5B</jats:italic> were colocalized with known plant height (PH) genes <jats:italic>Rht8</jats:italic>, <jats:italic>Rht‐D1</jats:italic>, and flowering date (FD) gene <jats:italic>Vrn‐B1</jats:italic>. However, <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐6B</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐3A</jats:italic> were not associated with PH and FD. Kompetitive Allele‐Specific PCR markers for <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐6B</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐3A</jats:italic> had been developed and validated in an additional panel of 211 wheat cultivars/lines. The result showed that these two resistance alleles decreased 46.65% of the percentage of diseased spikelets. These results provide valuable information for the fine mapping of <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐6B</jats:italic> and <jats:italic>QFhb.yaas‐3A</jats:italic> in the future.</jats:p>
title: Molecular mapping of QTL for type I Fusarium head blight resistance in two recombinant inbred lines wheat populations
